Kimberly — quick answers:

- For first 12 months web/ticket + dedicated Slack channel is OK. If we go prod at scale, we'll likely require phone escalation.

From: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
To: Tom Elliott <tom.elliott@acme-data.com>, kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2026 11:16:00 -0800

Tom, Samira — appreciate the clarity. Below is our proposed commercial for a 12-month committed plan with the burst profile you described: 

Proposal (12-month commit) — Acme Data Platform
- Baseline throughput pricing: $0.018 / inference request (metered token-equivalent) for committed volume up to 1M requests/day average.
- Uptime tiers & credits: 99.95 (SLO) — 4 hour priority response; 99.9 — 8 hour response; 99.5 — 24 hour response. Credits scale: 10% / 5% / 2% of monthly invoice respectively.
- Priority on-call seats: $3,000 / seat / month (includes access to priority Slack routing and advanced runbook support).
- Seat-swap policy: up to 2 seat swaps/month across regions at no extra fee; additional swaps $500/swap. Swaps require 72-hour notice.
- Burst protection: automatic temporary burst buffer for up to 3x baseline sustained for 48 hours; larger bursts trigger tiered overage at 1.5x baseline price.

Promotional concession (sales-authorized): 15% off total invoice for the first 12 months if you sign by March 31, 2026 and agree to a 12-month committed spend minimum (we can discuss the minimum level in the next call).

We will add a narrow SLA clause for regional failover and an escalation path (web -> Slack -> phone) tied to the response windows above. Draft clause is in the attached SLA PDF.

Let me know if the seat-swap cadence and burst handling match your needs and I will generate a clean quote and draft SOW for legal review.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Principal Sales, Redwood Inference

Tom / Samira — agreed with Aditya's commercial outline. For this opportunity I'm authorizing the 15% first-year promotional concession described, with the following operational caveats to limit risk:

- Promotion applies only to platform + priority seats, not to overage charges or third-party infra pass-through.
- Seat-swap policy capped at 2 swaps/month with 72-hour notice; any emergency ad-hoc regional reassignments may be treated as a swap and billed if outside notice window.
- We will include a 30-day right-to-terminate clause tied to material non-performance (e.g., repeated missed SLOs) with proportionate invoice adjustments and a single 30-day remediation period before termination rights kick in.

Action items:
- Kimberly: please generate the formal quote and SOW (include the promotional 15% and seat-swap terms).
- Aditya: draft the short SLA addendum with the regional failover and remediation language for legal.

Tom/Samira: if this matches your expectations I will ask legal to prepare the DocuSign and route procurement paperwork.
